name: Forest-Section Gluing Bound
statement: If the section incidence graph $G_D$ is a forest and the least piece margin is $t>0$, put $\alpha=2t/(1+t)$, let $L$ be half the largest distance between coordinate vertices in one component, and set $u=t\alpha^L$. Then $u^2/(1+2u)\le\mu(X)\le t$.
proof: Root each incidence tree at a coordinate and propagate positive coordinate scales so every transformed section row becomes uniform. The coefficient lower bound confines the scale ratio to $\alpha^{-L}$; section-row compatibility then supplies the displayed union certificate.
